concepts.label: I1 书本对话
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: preview-only iOS app-icon design study for an offline four-volume English-learning app used by Chinese, Japanese and Korean readers. Create a polished square presentation board, roughly 1024x1024, clean pure white background. One large iOS rounded-square icon centered in the upper two-thirds of the board, with two smaller copies of exactly the same icon centered below, to compare small-size readability. The large icon is about 570 pixels wide; small copies roughly 96 and 60 pixels wide, evenly separated, not nested. A small restrained charcoal heading at the top gives ONLY the identifier specified below. No other board text or annotations. Icon design must be unique original graphics, NOT any publisher logo, not an existing app logo. Coordinate with mature illustrated paperback covers using graceful charcoal ink illustrations on white with burgundy, deep teal, blue and gold accents. Icon itself should be bolder and far simpler than those cover drawings. Adult, thoughtful, polished editorial identity with a slight human hand-ink character, precise and uncluttered. Strong silhouette, large generous graphic, legible at small sizes. No Chinese, Japanese, Korean, flags, author names, ornate publisher crest, glossy gradients, plastic/clay 3D, screenshots, photorealistic objects, extra decorations, book titles, fine page text, marketing copy or watermarks. Present the entire icon and previews without cropping. Board heading exact 'I1'. Icon: deep teal solid background, a single large warm-white original emblem combining an open book and one speech bubble as ONE connected shape. Book broad and calm, two clear page silhouettes with just one center fold, no dense page-line hatching. Speech bubble arises from the upper right book page, with one bold burgundy short horizontal speaking stroke rather than tiny three dots. Emblem occupies 68 percent of the icon, low balanced center. Slight organic variation in ink edges but not ragged. Two-color print-like aesthetic, almost flat silkscreen, crisp contrast. NOT a standalone bubble floating over a highly detailed textbook; integrate book and conversation into a memorable simplified logo.
